messages.subject: density plot
parts:
Hello everyone

I have a scatterplot of bootstrapped data and I would like to draw the density line that includes 95% of the points in ggplot.

so far I did it with the contour() function after I calculated the density with the dmvnorm() function of the mtvnorm package

Example:

library(mvtnorm)
#scatterplot
Exmpl<-data.frame(rnorm(1000,50,10),rnorm(10000,50,7))
#matrix of qunatiles for the dmvnorm function
xx=seq(10,100,0.5)
yy=seq(10,100,0.5)
xmult=cbind(rep(seq(10,100,0.5),181),rep(seq(10,100,0.5),each=181))
# theoretical density for all x,y pairs in xmult with mean mean(Exmpl)
# and covariance cov(Exmpl)
dens=dmvnorm(xmult,mean(Exmpl),cov(Exmpl))
#density matrix for contour()
dmat=matrix(dens,ncol=length(yy),nrow=length(xx),byrow=F)
####calculating 95% CI ####
#theoretical density for all x,y pairs of Exmpl
dens1=dmvnorm(Exmpl,mean(Exmpl),cov(Exmpl))
#extracting denisty value that includes 95% of points
bb<-cbind(Exmpl,dens1)
bb<-bb[sort.list(bb[,3]), ]
aa<-(length(bb[,3])/100)*5
#scatterplot and densityline including 95% of the values
plot(Exmpl,pch=21,cex=0.2,xlab="x",ylab="y")
contour(xx,yy,dmat,levels=bb[aa,3],drawlabels=F,lwd=3,add=T,col=2)

In my graph I have several pairs of bootstrapped data and I overplot the 95% CI density lines to compare the distributions graphically.

Does someone now how to reproduce this with ggplot?

Thanks for your help!

best

Fabian

It's a fairly straight forward conversion, once you clean up your code
a bit (space are free, you know!).

ex <- data.frame(x = rnorm(1000, 50, 10), y = rnorm(10000, 50, 7))
ex_mu <- sapply(ex, mean)
ex_sigma <- cov(ex)

ex$dens <- dmvnorm(as.matrix(ex), ex_mu, ex_sigma)
cutoff <- quantile(ex$dens, 0.05)

# Create grid of estimated densities (assuming normality)
dgrid <- with(ex, expand.grid(
x = seq(min(x), max(x), length = 100),
y = seq(min(y), max(y), length = 100),
KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
))
dgrid$dens <- dmvnorm(as.matrix(dgrid), ex_mu, ex_sigma)

ggplot(ex, aes(x, y)) +
geom_point(alpha = 1/10) +
geom_contour(aes(z = dens), data = dgrid, breaks = cutoff, size = 2)
